newsitem.title: GERMANY: German traders seek free market grain rebates.
newsitem.headline: German traders seek free market grain rebates.

text.p: German grain traders sought rebates in a 14.95-16.50 Ecus a tonne range for the intended export of 4,800 tonnes of free market soft wheat, the state grain intervention board BLE said on Thursday.
Traders also sought export restitutions in a 30.98-34.98 Ecus/tonne range for 6,000 tonnes of free market barley exports at the EU's weekly export tender.
In addition, they applied for a 31.47 Ecu subsidy for the export of 6,000 tonnes of free market rye.
